name: Faceted Search Aggregations over Semi-Structured JSON Attributes
description: When a customer searches for 'laptops', e-commerce search engines return matching items along with dynamic facet counts (e.g. Brand: Apple (12), Dell (8); RAM: 16GB (15), 32GB (5)) extracted from JSON specs.
prompt:
When a customer searches for 'laptops', e-commerce search engines return matching items along with dynamic facet counts (e.g. Brand: Apple (12), Dell (8); RAM: 16GB (15), 32GB (5)) extracted from JSON specs.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: facet_dimension, facet_value, match_count.
Results should be ordered as specified.
golden_sql:
-- Extract faceted breakdown of matching laptop brands and RAM capacities
            WITH matching_items AS (
                SELECT 
                    item_id,
                    title,
                    specs->>'brand' AS brand,
                    specs->>'ram' AS ram
                FROM electronics_catalog
            )
            SELECT 
                'brand' AS facet_dimension,
                brand AS facet_value,
                COUNT(*) AS match_count
            FROM matching_items
            GROUP BY brand
            UNION ALL
            SELECT 
                'ram' AS facet_dimension,
                ram AS facet_value,
                COUNT(*) AS match_count
            FROM matching_items
            GROUP BY ram
            ORDER BY facet_dimension, match_count DESC, facet_value ASC;
why_it_fails: Running separate queries for each facet dimension multiplies query latency and database load.
